cards.front: Complète : If they ___ earlier, they ___ the crisis. (act/avoid)
cards.back: If they had acted earlier, they might have avoided the crisis.

cards.front: Complète : If we had invested earlier, the system ___ safer now. (be)
cards.back: If we had invested earlier, the system would be safer now.

cards.front: Reformule sans if : If they had known, they would have acted.
cards.back: Had they known, they would have acted.

cards.front: Reformule sans if : If I were you, I would wait.
cards.back: Were I you, I would wait.

cards.front: Traduis : « à condition que des garanties soient ajoutées ».

cards.front: Relie avec otherwise : Act now. The problem will worsen.
cards.back: Act now; otherwise, the problem will worsen.

cards.front: Traduis : « Tu n'avais pas besoin de venir, mais tu es venu. »
cards.back: You needn't have come.
